def mk(h,w,bg,edge_color,edge_bars,points):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for side,start,end,idx in edge_bars:
        for k in range(start,end):
            if side=='top': g[0][k]=edge_color
            elif side=='bottom': g[h-1][k]=edge_color
            elif side=='left': g[k][0]=edge_color
